claims.value: AIPT — AI Premium Tools is the seller/support entity; third-party service names and trademarks belong to their providers.
Checkout prices and orders are denominated in BDT.
Current checkout methods are bKash, Nagad, and Bank Transfer.
AIPT products are digitally fulfilled after payment confirmation; there is no physical shipment or shipping fee. Customer contact/fulfilment uses the checkout phone/WhatsApp workflow.
Product counts shown to users must be derived from the current production catalog/API, not a hardcoded marketing number.
Approved product reviews come from the reviews table. A review is labelled Verified buyer only when it is linked to a matching order.
Provider authorization, resale rights, customer-owned procurement, or approved seat rights are never inferred; missing AIPT-specific evidence remains HOLD.
Structured data must not describe physical returns/shipping for these digital products. Public policy copy must avoid unsupported universal numeric SLA or warranty claims.
